name: v9-grammar
note: V9-1, the screen V8_REPORT.md section 5 proposes: does training on compositions carry across families when the parts come from the training families' own operations? Grammar v2 (ycode.lm.compositions2): integer-list views, digits, characters and words, every part taken from one of the 123 V8 training families; 693 behaviours after held-out, v5-trained, test-skeleton and test-behaviour exclusions. Before training it can express 5 of the 66 held-out-family tasks (ycode/lm/v9_grammar_split.json: expressible_t_families). C2 trains 350 combinations (105 / 85 / 55 / 105 per domain) x 3 examples, 50% replay, lr 1e-4, seed 1301, from round 54. 56 steps instead of the pre-registered 52: grammar v2's longer task texts make the data 14% larger (238k tokens), and 56 steps is one epoch, as 52 was for COMP. The benchmark is evaluated and reported only.
decision: Development tasks only; the benchmark is reported, never used to choose. Pre-registered (V8_REPORT.md section 5): run a second seed only if held-out families reach >= 6/66 (round 54: 2) with dev + unseen-v1 >= 27. A candidate replaces round 54 only under the V6 rule (every seed beats 29, mean gain >= 3, no category loses >= 3).
